# Setup

Loads `tidyverse`, `arrow`, and `brms`, and sets `knitr::opts_chunk$set(error = FALSE)`. Defines `french_rates()`, `french_fit_gompertz()`, and helpers for fitted curves and lag plots.

```{r packages, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(error = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
library(brms)
```

```{r helpers, include=FALSE}
# Monthly and cumulative rates against full monthly token totals. Child months
# 0-10 are zero baselines; with drop_zero_months, later months in which a
# series does not occur are left out of its cumulative denominator.
french_rates <- function(counts, totals, drop_zero_months = TRUE) {
  counts %>%
    complete(series, speaker = "child", age = 0:10, fill = list(freq = 0L)) %>%
    left_join(totals, by = c("speaker", "age")) %>%
    mutate(
      total = replace_na(total, 0L),
      freq = if_else(speaker == "child" & age <= 10, 0L, freq),
      relfreq = if_else(total > 0, freq / total, 0),
      ppt = relfreq * 1000,
      pct = relfreq * 100
    ) %>%
    filter(!drop_zero_months | freq > 0 | (speaker == "child" & age <= 10)) %>%
    group_by(series, speaker) %>%
    arrange(age, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      cum_freq = cumsum(freq),
      cum_total = cumsum(total),
      cumulative_relfreq = if_else(cum_total > 0, cum_freq / cum_total, 0),
      cumulative_ppt = cumulative_relfreq * 1000
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}

# Bayesian Gompertz curve; refits only when the data or model change.
french_fit_gompertz <- function(data, outcome, upper_bound, file_name) {
  brm(
    bf(
      as.formula(paste(
        outcome, "~ upperAsymptote * exp(-exp(((growthRate * exp(1)) /",
        "upperAsymptote) * (lag - age) + 1))"
      )),
      upperAsymptote ~ 1, growthRate ~ 1, lag ~ 1,
      nl = TRUE
    ),
    data = data,
    prior = c(
      set_prior(sprintf("uniform(0, %s)", upper_bound),
                nlpar = "upperAsymptote", lb = 0, ub = upper_bound),
      prior(uniform(0, 10), nlpar = "growthRate", lb = 0, ub = 10),
      prior(uniform(10, 72), nlpar = "lag", lb = 10, ub = 72)
    ),
    file = file.path(french_model_dir, file_name),
    file_refit = "on_change",
    iter = 10000,
    seed = 16
  )
}

extract_negation_lag <- function(model, language_name, word_name, category_name) {
  model_summary <- brms::fixef(model)
  if (!"lag_Intercept" %in% rownames(model_summary)) {
    stop("Cannot find lag_Intercept for ", language_name, ": ", word_name)
  }
  lag_summary <- model_summary["lag_Intercept", ]
  tibble(
    language = language_name,
    category = category_name,
    word = word_name,
    Estimate = unname(lag_summary["Estimate"]),
    Est.Error = unname(lag_summary["Est.Error"]),
    Q2.5 = unname(lag_summary["Q2.5"]),
    Q97.5 = unname(lag_summary["Q97.5"])
  )
}

# Child observations (black) and fitted values (blue).
french_fit_plot <- function(data, y, title, y_label) {
  ggplot(data, aes(age, .data[[y]])) +
    geom_point(color = "black", size = 2) +
    geom_line(aes(y = predictions), color = "blue", linewidth = 1, na.rm = TRUE) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Child Age (Months)", y = y_label) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 14)
    )
}

plot_negation_scope_onset <- function(onset_data, category_name) {
  plot_title <- paste(unique(onset_data$language), category_name, "Negation")
  plot_data <- onset_data %>%
    filter(category == category_name, is.finite(Estimate)) %>%
    mutate(word = forcats::fct_reorder(word, Estimate))

  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0L) {
    return(
      ggplot() +
        theme_void() +
        annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, label = "No fitted lag estimate available") +
        labs(title = plot_title)
    )
  }

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Estimate, y = word)) +
    geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = Q2.5, xmax = Q97.5)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 72, by = 6)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 72)) +
    labs(title = plot_title, x = "Fitted lag (months)", y = NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12)
}

french_save_plot <- function(plot, name) {
  saveRDS(plot, file.path(french_data_dir, paste0(name, ".RDS")))
}
```

# Load Data

Loads `french_tokens_processed` from the processed Feather file and counts monthly tokens and negators by `speaker` and `age`. Checks for the `n_pas`, `n_non`, `n_non_sentential`, and `n_non_discourse` columns produced by extraction.

```{r load_data}
french_data_dir <- "../french/french_data/processed_data"
french_model_dir <- "../french/french_model/modeling"
dir.create(french_model_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

french_tokens_processed <- read_feather(
  file.path(french_data_dir, "french_tokens_processed.feather")
)

french_missing_columns <- setdiff(
  c("speaker", "age", "syncategory",
    "n_pas", "n_non", "n_non_sentential", "n_non_discourse"),
  names(french_tokens_processed)
)
if (length(french_missing_columns) > 0L) {
  stop("Rerun the extraction file. Missing columns: ",
       paste(french_missing_columns, collapse = ", "))
}

french_speaker_age_totals <- french_tokens_processed %>%
  count(speaker, age, name = "total") %>%
  complete(speaker = "child", age = 0:10, fill = list(total = 0L)) %>%
  mutate(total = if_else(speaker == "child" & age <= 10, 0L, total)) %>%
  arrange(speaker, age)

french_negation_counts <- french_tokens_processed %>%
  group_by(speaker, age) %>%
  summarise(
    negation = sum(n_pas + n_non),
    pas = sum(n_pas),
    non = sum(n_non),
    non_sentential = sum(n_non_sentential),
    non_discourse = sum(n_non_discourse),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(speaker, age), names_to = "series", values_to = "freq")
```

# Calculate Relative Frequencies

Calculates monthly and cumulative rates in `french_syncategory_relfreq`, `french_wordcategory_relfreq`, and `french_functionword_relfreq`. Retains every month for overall negation and drops later zero-occurrence months from the individual negator and scope series.

```{r relfreq}
french_syncategory_relfreq <- french_tokens_processed %>%
  count(syncategory, speaker, age, name = "freq") %>%
  rename(series = syncategory) %>%
  complete(nesting(speaker, age), series = c("Function", "nonfunction"),
           fill = list(freq = 0L)) %>%
  french_rates(french_speaker_age_totals, drop_zero_months = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(syncategory = series, speaker, age, freq, total, relfreq, pct,
            cum_freq, cum_total, cumulative_relfreq,
            cumulative_pct = cumulative_relfreq * 100)

french_wordcategory_relfreq <- french_negation_counts %>%
  filter(series == "negation") %>%
  french_rates(french_speaker_age_totals, drop_zero_months = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(word_category = "Negation", speaker, age, freq, total, relfreq,
            ppt, pct, cum_freq, cum_total, cumulative_relfreq)

french_series_relfreq <- french_negation_counts %>%
  filter(series != "negation") %>%
  french_rates(french_speaker_age_totals)

french_functionword_relfreq <- french_series_relfreq %>%
  filter(series %in% c("pas", "non")) %>%
  transmute(word = series, speaker, age, freq, total, relfreq, ppt,
            cum_freq, cum_total, cumulative_relfreq, cumulative_ppt)

saveRDS(french_syncategory_relfreq,
        file.path(french_data_dir, "french_syncategory_relfreq.RDS"))
saveRDS(french_wordcategory_relfreq,
        file.path(french_data_dir, "french_wordcategory_relfreq.RDS"))
saveRDS(french_functionword_relfreq,
        file.path(french_data_dir, "french_functionword_relfreq.RDS"))
```

# Plot and Fit Growth Curves

Plots speaker-level negation rates and fits Bayesian Gompertz curves to child `pct` and `cumulative_ppt` trajectories. Produces fitted child data and lag summaries for onset comparisons.

## Overall Negation

Plots monthly `pct` from `french_wordcategory_relfreq` by `speaker` and fits `french_negation_words_lagModel` to child values. Saves `french_negation_words_childdata` with `predictions` and displays the fitted curve.

```{r negation_plot}
french_wordcategory_relfreq %>%
  ggplot(aes(age, pct)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_grid(. ~ speaker) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(title = "Negation", x = "Age (Months)", y = "Monthly Percent of Tokens") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 14))
```

```{r negation_model, include=FALSE}
french_negation_words_childdata <- french_wordcategory_relfreq %>%
  filter(speaker == "child") %>%
  arrange(age)

french_negation_words_lagModel <- french_fit_gompertz(
  french_negation_words_childdata, "pct", 100, "french_negation_words_lagModel"
)

french_negation_words_childdata$predictions <-
  fitted(french_negation_words_lagModel)[, "Estimate"]

saveRDS(french_negation_words_childdata,
        file.path(french_data_dir, "french_negation_words_childdata.RDS"))
```

```{r negation_fit_plot}
french_fit_plot(french_negation_words_childdata, "pct",
                "Negation", "Monthly Percent of Tokens")
```

## Individual Negators

Plots `cumulative_ppt` for `pas` and `non` by `speaker` and fits child Gompertz curves for both words and scope-specific `non`. Saves fitted child tables and model objects for word and scope onset comparisons.

```{r word_plot}
french_functionword_relfreq %>%
  ggplot(aes(age, cumulative_ppt)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_grid(word ~ speaker, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Age (Months)", y = "Cumulative Occurrences per 1,000 Tokens") +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r series_models, include=FALSE}
french_series_models <- c(
  pas = "french_pas_lagModel",
  non = "french_non_lagModel",
  non_sentential = "french_non_sentential_lagModel",
  non_discourse = "french_non_discourse_lagModel"
)

french_fits <- imap(french_series_models, function(file_name, series_name) {
  childdata <- french_series_relfreq %>%
    filter(series == series_name, speaker == "child") %>%
    arrange(age)
  if (!any(childdata$freq > 0)) {
    stop("No child tokens for ", series_name, " are available for modeling.")
  }
  model <- french_fit_gompertz(
    childdata, "cumulative_ppt",
    max(5, ceiling(max(childdata$cumulative_ppt) * 2)), file_name
  )
  childdata$predictions <- fitted(model)[, "Estimate"]
  list(data = childdata, model = model)
})

french_pas_childdata <- french_fits$pas$data %>% rename(word = series)
french_non_childdata <- french_fits$non$data %>% rename(word = series)

saveRDS(french_pas_childdata,
        file.path(french_data_dir, "french_pas_childdata.RDS"))
saveRDS(french_non_childdata,
        file.path(french_data_dir, "french_non_childdata.RDS"))
```

```{r word_fit_plots}
french_pas_plot <- french_fit_plot(french_pas_childdata, "cumulative_ppt",
                                   "pas", "Cumulative Occurrences per 1,000 Tokens")
french_non_plot <- french_fit_plot(french_non_childdata, "cumulative_ppt",
                                   "non", "Cumulative Occurrences per 1,000 Tokens")
french_pas_plot
french_non_plot
```

## Sentential and Discourse Negation

Combines fitted `pas` and `non_sentential` series into `french_sentential_negation_childdata` and the `non_discourse` series into `french_discourse_negation_childdata`. Saves and displays the corresponding observed and fitted scope plots.

```{r scope_curves}
french_scope_childdata <- function(series_names, scope) {
  bind_rows(map(french_fits[series_names], "data")) %>%
    mutate(word = if_else(series == "pas", "pas", "non"),
           negation_category = word,
           negation_scope = scope) %>%
    select(-series) %>%
    relocate(word)
}

french_sentential_negation_childdata <-
  french_scope_childdata(c("pas", "non_sentential"), "sentential")
french_discourse_negation_childdata <-
  french_scope_childdata("non_discourse", "discourse")

saveRDS(french_sentential_negation_childdata,
        file.path(french_data_dir, "french_sentential_negation_childdata.RDS"))
saveRDS(french_discourse_negation_childdata,
        file.path(french_data_dir, "french_discourse_negation_childdata.RDS"))

french_sentential_negation_child_plot <- french_fit_plot(
  french_sentential_negation_childdata, "cumulative_ppt",
  "Sentential Negation in Children", "Cumulative Occurrences per 1,000 Tokens"
) + facet_wrap(~ negation_category, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y")

french_discourse_negation_child_plot <- french_fit_plot(
  french_discourse_negation_childdata, "cumulative_ppt",
  "Discourse Negation in Children", "Cumulative Occurrences per 1,000 Tokens"
) + facet_wrap(~ negation_category, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y")

french_save_plot(french_sentential_negation_child_plot,
                 "french_sentential_negation_child_plot")
french_save_plot(french_discourse_negation_child_plot,
                 "french_discourse_negation_child_plot")

french_sentential_negation_child_plot
french_discourse_negation_child_plot
```

# Scope Onset Estimates

Extracts `lag_Intercept` and 95% credible intervals from `french_fits` into `french_negation_scope_age_of_production`. Saves and displays separate sentential and discourse onset plots.

```{r scope_onset}
french_negation_scope_age_of_production <- bind_rows(
  extract_negation_lag(french_fits$pas$model, "French", "pas", "Sentential"),
  extract_negation_lag(french_fits$non_sentential$model, "French", "non", "Sentential"),
  extract_negation_lag(french_fits$non_discourse$model, "French", "non", "Discourse")
)

saveRDS(french_negation_scope_age_of_production,
        file.path(french_data_dir, "french_negation_scope_age_of_production.RDS"))

french_sentential_negation_onset_plot <-
  plot_negation_scope_onset(french_negation_scope_age_of_production, "Sentential")
french_discourse_negation_onset_plot <-
  plot_negation_scope_onset(french_negation_scope_age_of_production, "Discourse")

french_save_plot(french_sentential_negation_onset_plot,
                 "french_sentential_negation_onset_plot")
french_save_plot(french_discourse_negation_onset_plot,
                 "french_discourse_negation_onset_plot")

french_negation_scope_age_of_production
french_sentential_negation_onset_plot
french_discourse_negation_onset_plot
```

# Word Onset Estimates

Extracts `lag_Intercept` from the `pas` and `non` models into `french_age_of_production` and plots lag estimates with 95% credible intervals. Interprets these values as fitted lag parameters rather than observed first-production ages.

```{r word_onset}
french_age_of_production <- bind_rows(
  extract_negation_lag(french_fits$pas$model, "French", "pas", "Word"),
  extract_negation_lag(french_fits$non$model, "French", "non", "Word")
) %>%
  select(word, Estimate, Est.Error, Q2.5, Q97.5) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 1)),
         word = fct_reorder(word, Estimate))

french_age_of_production

ggplot(french_age_of_production, aes(x = Estimate, y = word)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = Q2.5, xmax = Q97.5)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 72, by = 3)) +
  labs(x = "Age (Months)", y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12))
```
